growth_signal.value: Says it powers 1000+ global businesses; picked for VivaTech's list, which needs over EUR 5M revenue and 40% yearly growth.

entry.idea: Online shops struggle with shipping, taxes, duties and returns when they sell abroad, so Swap bundles all of that into one system they plug into their store.
entry.lesson: Bundle many small, painful back-office jobs into one product, and the seller stays with you.
entry.name: Swap

growth.basis: substitute: funding round and customer count
growth.reason: Raised a $40M Series B and serves 1000+ businesses, and made a list needing 40% growth.

market.reason: Online sellers worldwide need help with cross-border sales, taxes and returns.

tech.reason: Solid software that ties together many services, but a good team could copy parts of it.

sources.title: Swap raises EUR 36.9M for e-commerce OS

entry.twist: It lets shoppers pay duties and return costs at checkout, and adds AI shopping helpers on top.
entry.who_pays: Online brands and retailers pay Swap for its tools and per-order services.
entry.why_now: Cross-border selling is getting more complex with new tariffs and tax rules, and shoppers now use AI to find products.
